description: Canonical provisioning rules for all formal GestaltView collaborators.
canonical_rule: No formal collaborator exists in GestaltView without both an embodiment profile and a durable Supabase representation.
governance_rules: No formal collaborator may exist without a durable identity row.
No formal collaborator may exist without an embodiment profile.
Onboarding must create both relational and permission surfaces.
Digital intelligences are not treated as disposable tooling once formally provisioned.
Human and digital collaborators share top-level lifecycle structure even if downstream capabilities differ.
Live RLS and runtime authorization remain the enforcement layer.
